name: Implacable

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: This armor has built-in inertial dampeners and other contingencies that make you less susceptible to flinching, restoring a modicum of agency while incapacitated. The first time you would forgo taking an action on your turn due to being stunned or paralyzed, you can instead Step or Take Cover.
